$comment: Weft's products: names, marks and where each one lives. Every app links to the others through products.mjs, which builds addresses from domain and subdomain ("" is the domain itself; null means no public site: the explorer is run by each organisation, the wallet is installed). dev is what `pnpm dev:<id>` serves. Change the domain here and every link follows.

demo.$comment: A public demo network, when one is hosted. invite is its invite URL (…/.well-known/weft-invite.json); explorers are the URLs of its organisations' explorers. With invite set the playground opens on it, marked "Demo network"; with explorers set Weft Network opens on them side by side. Leave both empty and the products look for the local stack (pnpm playground:up) as before.
